port.ask: Serial port the EUROSTAR station or its Wireless Controller appears on (COM3, /dev/ttyUSB0, /dev/tty.usbserial-*)
port.help: USB: install the IKA USB driver first; the station then shows up as a virtual COM port. RS-232: the port of the PC 1.1 cable.

baud.ask: Baud rate (the station is fixed at 9600)
